bugs_found: transfer allows self-transfer because the self-transfer guard is dead; it can mint a valid Receipt for no real movement
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, unlike the other money functions, causing inconsistent behavior and possible TypeError or non-Decimal Receipt amounts
transfer is not atomic: debit is applied before credit, so a failure during credit can leave balances inconsistent
apply_fee can return a negative payout when fee_min/fee_max or fee_pct produce a fee greater than amount
fx_convert accepts zero or negative FX rates, producing zero/negative converted money
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing caller intent without validation
